selectionReason: The next fifteen, in source-row order, of the absent frozen rows at least one of whose KANJIDIC2 readings is used by an existing word article that declares the kanji (an automatic alignment of each word's kana against the kanji's readings), the rule announced on issue 60 after batch 136. No word article is added: 20 existing articles each gain one link to a new card, and two of them (附属, 酌む) also drop a sentence saying the new card did not exist yet. A card quizzes each reading that a declaring word article uses, unless the pinned JMdict marks the spelling as ateji or the reading as gikun; name-only readings are never quizzed; a reading type with no such reading gets an empty quizzed list. All fifteen pass, so none is set aside. All fifteen quizzed readings are in the official Joyo table. 酔っ払い, 釣り and 釣り合う use the readings 酔 よ, 釣 つ.り and つ.り-, which share a stem with the quizzed よ.う and つ.る; the app asks one question per stem, so these articles are linked on their own rows, which are not quizzed. One existing card (属) also changes in its remarks: the sentence that said 附 had no card here now links it. No other line of a word article or an existing card changes. 16 rows of the 106-row group, 11 rows whose declaring articles use none of their KANJIDIC2 readings, and 644 rows with no declaring article remain.

review.execution: All four runs started after the previous one ended. The two initial runs and confirm-gpt had at most one tool call in flight. confirm-claude once issued two read-only calls at once, at 01:30:59 UTC: a Select-String search of the original packet's titles/kanji-titles.tsv and a view of the revised 醜.md; its report discloses this. Its final message is not identical to its saved report but contains it (similarity 0.98); the closure keeps the saved report. The initial-gpt audit flags one write outside the report path; this is a false positive: the report was written through a relative path that resolves to reports-153/initial-gpt.md. The audits find no path outside the allowed folders and no corpus scan. Each confirmation was a fresh agent of the same model family, given the author's statement on its family's initial report and allowed to read the original packet and that report. Both families confirmed the same final commit 3f8b951d, which was written before either confirmation started.
